list.title: Boards
list.subtitle: Infinite whiteboards for your team. Everyone in the workspace can open and edit them.
list.emptyHint: Sketch, plan and share an idea on an infinite canvas.
list.createError: Couldn’t create the board. Try again.

share.title: Share by link
share.hint: Anyone with the link can view this board. Only your workspace can edit it.

editor.name: Board name
editor.renameError: Couldn't rename. Press Enter to try again.
editor.tooLarge: This board is over {mb} MB, usually because of images. Remove or shrink some images to keep saving.
editor.conflictDeleted: This board changed somewhere else: something you edited was deleted there, or you deleted something that was edited there. Everything else is already combined.
editor.conflictDeletedBy: {name} changed this board: something you edited was deleted on their side, or you deleted something they edited. Everything else is already combined.
editor.draftFound: There are changes from your last visit that didn't get saved.

retro.name: Retrospective
retro.description: What went well, what to improve and the actions to take.
retro.title: Sprint retro
retro.hint: Add a note to each column, then vote on what to tackle first.

brainstorm.name: Brainstorm
brainstorm.description: A central topic with room for ideas around it.
brainstorm.title: Brainstorm

userFlow.name: User flow
userFlow.description: Screens and decisions from the first visit to the goal.
userFlow.title: User flow

kanban.name: Kanban
kanban.description: Backlog, to do, in progress and done.
kanban.title: Kanban

roadmap.name: Roadmap
roadmap.description: Initiatives by team across four quarters.
roadmap.title: Roadmap

history.title: Version history
history.hint: A version is saved every hour while the board is being edited, for 30 days. Restoring opens it as a new board and leaves this one as it is.
history.empty: No versions yet. The first one is saved after an hour of editing.

comments.placeHint: Click on the board to place a comment. Esc cancels.

comments.placeholder: Write a comment. Type @ to mention someone.
